bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 9. DANCE GAVIN DANCE will be making his home track debut when he presents in search of a hat-trick today. Winkers were added to his gear before he indicated at Grafton last start that he will now appreciate the distance rise which awaits. POSEIDON'S SON is resuming after trialing on three occasions and he should have no issues whatsoever with this journey first up, aided by the claim for Grady Spokes. TIGER TIE was anything but disgraced when he finished unplaced at home (Eagle Farm) last start. He's proven away from his home base and this race will be within his reach when he now makes a Lismore debut. KING JESTER refused to shirk his task after he struck a traffic problem last start at Toowoomba and he should be treated with respect this afternoon.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 5, 6. CONSTELLATION stepped up into this distance range third up at Grafton when his effort was full of merit. He was produced fresh on the day, he presents fresh again here and this race is within his reach. SHREDDED resumes after winning trials recently at Murwillumbah and then at Deagon. He did all but win within this distance range first up last preparation at Murwillumbah and he's suitably placed today, first up. WARRIOR BAE must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort at Grafton when he had far too much to do from a wide gate. SWIFTIES presents for the third time since a long spell and also since a stable change. Switching from the metropolitan circuit at Eagle Farm and then at Doomben aids her cause today. ENHANCE struck trouble before he still performed above market place expectations at Grafton. He's been in work for some time but there's no evidence to suggest that he might not maintain his form today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 9, 11, 12, 15. TRANSGRESS finished unplaced after gear changes were made last start at Ipswich. His effort was however better than it appears on paper and he's better suited today, making a Lismore debut. CAISHEN begins his third campaign today. He presents after a sixty-four day break and he can therefore cope with the significant distance switch that awaits him aided by the claim for Archie McColm. GOLD PUMA was produced after an almost seven week break at Grafton when she clearly indicated that this awaiting distance rise will aid her cause, after a much quicker back-up. ICEWATER returns to his home base after performing below expectations at Grafton when he attempted to lead throughout. Even so, he wasn't disgraced on the day and stepping back in distance at his home track can be regarded as a plus.
